name: octaweave_update_file
description: Rename a file, move it to another folder, or trash/untrash it. Trashing ({trashed: true}) is REVERSIBLE and is what you should reach for instead of deleting — deletion is permanent and a file that a published post displays takes the post's images down with it.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

trashed.description: true moves it to the trash, false restores it.
